author: J.V.Lamouroux, 1809

note.en: A feathery green tuft known here from herbarium specimens at Punta Cahuita and Port Limón, hard to tell from other Bryopsis without a microscope.
note.es: Un mechón verde plumoso conocido aquí por especímenes de herbario de Punta Cahuita y Puerto Limón, difícil de distinguir de otras Bryopsis sin microscopio.

evidence: GBIF: 2 preserved specimens (Punta Cahuita 1999, Port Limón 1927)

sources.t: GBIF specimen records, Punta Cahuita and Port Limón
